text:
You need help finding USA-based IT startup companies and compiling founder or managing director contact details with company name, website, title, and direct business email.  

I can help with that. In a recent marketing attribution analysis for Verdant Skincare, I joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery and compared first-click, last-click, and position-based credit; that led to 18% of ad budget being reallocated and CAC down 12% the next quarter. I also built Shopify customer segments for Juniper & Ash Home using Google Sheets and Looker Studio; the top segment represented 9% of customers and 41% of revenue, and email revenue rose 19%.  

With 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data cleaning, and data visualization, I can build a clean, targeted prospect list for your lead generation needs.
